name: otto-roles
description: Search live jobs, match them to your CV, and have Otto fill in and submit the applications you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Otto Roles finds live job postings and applies to the ones you pick, without leaving the chat.

Ask for jobs in your words ("senior data engineer in Toronto", "remote product design roles") and Otto searches its corpus of live postings from employers' own application systems. Connect your Otto account and attach your CV, and Otto ranks postings by how well they fit it.

Pick the jobs you want on the cards and press Apply. ChatGPT shows you exactly which jobs it is about to apply to and asks you to confirm. Otto then fills in each employer's application form with your CV and saved answers and submits it, and the card shows each application's status as it goes. Otto emails you when each one is sent.

When a form asks something only you can answer, such as a salary figure or a notice period, Otto tells you what it needs and why, and you answer it in the chat. A verification code an employer emails you is entered on ottoroles.com, never in the chat, and Otto does not answer demographic questions on your behalf.

Searching works without an account. Applying needs an Otto account, created by signing in with Google or an email code.
